prompts.text: What is one belief you held as a child that you later found out was completely wrong?
Tell the group your honest first impression of the person to your left.
What is something you regret more than anything else, and what did it teach you?
Share one fear that you have never told anyone in this server before.
If you could change one decision you made in the last year, what would it be and why?
Confess one small lie you have told recently and why you told it.
What does a good day look like to you, from morning to night?
Who in your life knows you better than anyone else, and what makes them special?
Share the best piece of advice you have ever received, even if you did not follow it.
What is a topic you pretend to know about to impress people, but actually know nothing about?
What is the most important lesson life taught you that school never did?
Describe the moment in your life that changed who you are as a person.
What is something you wish people understood about you without you having to explain it?
What is one goal you have that you are too afraid to admit out loud?
Share the most meaningful compliment you have ever received and who it was from.
If you could have a two-hour conversation with anyone alive today, who would it be and why?
